dedupe_keys.name: qatar green spaces road medians and public parks statistics by municipality

description: Two datasets on the Qatar Open Data portal, published by the National Planning Council, record urban green infrastructure by municipality. The first gives, for each year from 2012 to 2023, the cultivated green areas, re-cultivated and maintained land, roadside cultivated area and median strips, and the areas of trees, shrubs and date palms, for Doha, Al Rayyan, Al Shamal, Al Wakra, Umm Salal, Al Khor and Al Daayen and the country total (72 records). The second gives the annual number of public parks by municipality from 2013 to 2023. Both are offered through the Opendatasoft platform with table, export and API access, and their metadata give the CC BY licence; the first was last modified on 28 May 2025. Access is free and open. Caveats: many cells are empty for some municipalities and years, the units differ between rows (square metres and kilometres), and the data is aggregated to municipalities without locations. Coverage is Qatar. It supports planning of green and blue infrastructure for urban heat and climate adaptation, and capacity planning of parks as public space; related records are the Azerbaijan greenery inventory portal and the Greener Spaces LGA green cover benchmark.
